integrity: The proof is analytic. It combines the exact Euclidean inradius/circumradius comparison, the parallelogram identity, and an explicit adjacent-vertex equality pair. The bundled script only replays representative polygon norms and a deterministic stress test; finite sampling is not used as proof of the infinite family. A highly relevant 2023 extreme-norm paper was inspected at metadata/abstract level only and is disclosed as a residual literature risk. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers Euclidean regular polygonal unit balls with side count divisible by 4. It does not determine the modified constant for the 2 modulo 4 regular-polygon family, the unrestricted von Neumann–Jordan constant, or higher modified n-th constants.
title: Modified von Neumann–Jordan constant of every regular \(4n\)-gonal Banach plane
